primary.description: Juniper green. The studio color: buttons, the logo, and section bands.

onPrimary.description: Labels and icons on juniper green (button text, reversed logo).

link.description: Text links on paper, white, and the card wash. A touch brighter than juniper so links stand out from text.

charcoal.description: Body text and headings. Softer than pure black on warm paper.

paper.description: Warm paper. The default page background for the website, proposals, and invoices.

white.description: Pure white. Photo mats, print margins, and forms where paper would look off-white.

blush.description: Blush accent. Thin rules, small shapes, and photo frames. Never use for text or behind white text.

wash.description: Soft sage wash. Card and callout backgrounds, like pricing boxes in a proposal.
